defs.def: to be used instead of sth/sb else; to do sth instead of sb/sth else 代替；取代

ex.s: Furthermore, AI-powered virtual guides are replacing traditional tour guides.
ex.t: 此外，由人工智能驱动的虚拟导览正在取代传统导游。

ex.s: Print texts cannot be entirely replaced in education.
ex.t: 纸质文本在教育中无法被完全取代。

ex.s: But I still don't want to replace them.
ex.t: 但我还是不想换掉它们。

ex.s: Which of the following can replace the underlined word "charts" in paragraph 2
ex.t: 年幼儿童需要更多自由时间

ex.s: Could glowing plants replace lamps?
ex.t: 如何使发光植物无污染？

ex.s: Nervousness and fear were replaced with   49  .
ex.t: 紧张和恐惧被宽慰所取代。

ex.s: Replacing them can be difficult.
ex.t: 它们不如塑料袋结实。

ex.s: Although she is clearly still in some pain, her scared and anxious look has been replaced —first by a small smile, and then by loud laughter as I "magically" produce her sock from out of my pocket.
ex.t: 虽然她显然仍然有些痛苦，但她害怕和焦虑的样子已经被取代了--首先是一个小小的微笑，然后是大声的笑声，因为我“神奇地”从口袋里掏出她的袜子。

ex.s: The large board in the corner had been replaced by a big screen, where customers’ comments on the month’s best-seller were being displayed.
ex.t: 角落里的大板子已被一块大屏幕取代，屏幕上显示着顾客对当月畅销书的评论。

ex.s: Even journalists are now being replaced with technology that can write basic news reports.
ex.t: 即使是记者现在也正在被能够撰写基本新闻报道的技术所取代。

ex.s: Our cities will be better places if we replace cars with bicycle.
ex.t: 如果我们用自行车取代汽车，我们的城市将会更美好。

ex.s: The team’s data only went up to 2007, but the researchers also explored what would happen if consumers replaced old products with new electronics that serve more than one function, such as a tablet for word processing and TV viewing.
ex.t: 团队的数据只统计到2007年，但研究人员还探讨了如果消费者用具有多种功能的新电子产品替代旧产品会发生什么，例如用于文字处理和看电视的平板电脑。

ex.s: These include plants that have sensors printed onto their leaves to show when they’re short of water and a plant that can detect harmful chemicals in groundwater. ＂We’re thinking about how we can engineer plants to replace functions of the things that we use every day,＂explained Michael Strano, a professor of chemical engineering at MIT.
ex.t: 这些包括叶子上印有传感器、能显示植物何时缺水的植物，以及一种能检测地下水中有害化学物质的植物。“我们正在思考如何改造植物，以取代我们日常使用物品的功能，”麻省理工学院化学工程教授Michael Strano解释道。

defs.def: to remove sb/sth and put another person or thing in their place （用 … ）替换；（以 … ）接替

ex.s: “The living-room television is replaced and gets planted in the kids’ room, and suddenly one day, you have a TV in every room of the house,” said one researcher.
ex.t: “客厅的电视被替换下来，装进了孩子的房间，于是一天，你突然发现家里每个房间都有一台电视了，”一位研究者说。

ex.s: Which of the following words can be used to replace the words underlined "stood in the way of"?
ex.t: 以下哪个词可以用来替换划线词组“stood in the way of”？

ex.s: Which of the following can replace the underlined phrase “work it out of her system”?
ex.t: 以下哪项可以替换划线短语“work it out of her system”？

ex.s: In a recycling economy, we would make one set of 100 cans to start with, then replace them over and over again with recycled cans.
ex.t: 在一个循环回收经济中，我们会先制造一组100个罐子，然后再用回收的罐子反复替换它们。

ex.s: The reason why they are doing this is that they think these words are irrelevant to children, so instead they’ve replaced them with terms like “film”.
ex.t: 他们这样做的原因是他们认为这些词与孩子们无关，所以他们用＂电影＂等词取而代之。

ex.s: “Oh, they’re replacing them with catamarans.
ex.t: "哦，他们要用双体船替换这些旧船。

ex.s: To replace the password system.
ex.t: 替换密码系统。

ex.s: A Shakespeare series for young readers has taken William Shakespeare’s popular plays and replaced some words with textspeak and emojis.
ex.t: 一套面向年轻读者的莎士比亚系列丛书选取了威廉\u00b7莎士比亚的流行戏剧，并将其中一些词替换为短信用语和表情符号。

ex.s: The last one standing has just been turned into a “mini community library”: any passer-by can “borrow” a book from its shelves, and return it later, or replace it with another title from their own collection.
ex.t: 最后一个幸存的电话亭刚刚被改造成了一个"迷你社区图书馆"：任何路人都可以从架子上"借"一本书，之后归还，或者用自己的藏书替换。

defs.def: to change sth that is old, damaged, etc. for a similar thing that is newer or better 更换；更新

ex.s: Time to Replace HouseplantsB.
ex.t: 更换室内植物的时候了 B.

ex.s: As I watched him take off his basketball uniform and replace it with a baseball uniform, I saw him leaving behind the layer that no longer served him, just as our lizard had.
ex.t: 当我看他脱下篮球服、换上棒球服时，我看到他丢下了那层不再适合他的外壳，就像我们的蜥蜴一样。

ex.s: The（2）     moment was quickly followed by mental math． How much time and money would it cost to replace the（3）     of that little wallet？ The credit cards， the driver's license， the cash， all lost to the bus．
ex.t: （2）____的那一刻紧接着便是心算。更换那个小钱包里的（3）____需要花费多少时间和金钱？信用卡、驾照、现金，全都落在了公交车上。

ex.s: She never replaced it.
ex.t: 她从未更换过它。

defs.def: to put sth back in the place where it was before 把 … 放回原处

ex.s: In spring, the snow was replaced by mud over ice.
ex.t: 在Wickenden的书中，她详细描述了西部的历史，也谈到了女权主义，这当然影响了女孩们去Elkhead的决定。

ex.s: When all those had been done, the road surface was replaced.
ex.t: 当所有这些都完成后，路面被恢复原状。

ex.s: When all those had been done, the road surface was replaced.
ex.t: 当所有这些都完成后，路面被恢复原状。

ex.s: By underinflating the front bags, the team allowed the platform carrying the tree to roll up the ramp and out of the hole while staying level, A trailer hauled the tree along as team members removed the airbags from the back of the platform and replaced them in the front.
ex.t: 通过给前袋少充气，团队让载树的平台在保持水平的情况下滚上坡道出坑，拖车拖着树前行，成员们从平台后方取下气囊补到前方。
